defining_decision_contradictions.what: A provisional default (v2-flashlite, staging p50 2.30 s; cut-ins 15-42% on every stack) and five 'available' stacks run production campaigns although none passes the <=1.5 s / <=5% gate; the gate is not in code (G10 refuses only beta); no human round 2. Owner-sanctioned as provisional (decision.2026-10-22.default-stack).
outcome.record_verified has no caller; integrations are never read; no upload path for verified outcomes; every outcome is an AI guess or a manager label.
HTTP tool endpoint and generated catalog exist; no MCP server and no SDK (MCP only in comments); in-call tools sit outside the registry and do nothing.
The gate trace is on attempt.precheck and the contact's attempt list, not on the call page, call.get or call.explain.
Live fast lane is a 50-call-window early-hang-up rate monitor (35%, min 20 calls); no per-moment detection; nothing throttles a script to 25%; only experiment arms have a harm stop.
Price not set (owner); the only wired carrier has a 60 s pulse and the estimate adds half a pulse per call, against the <=30 s rule for recommended paths.
What you see is not what runs: four inert tool switches, the Retry pattern select, the warm-summary toggle, integrations shown as connected.
